name: Edvenswa Enterprises Limited
about: Edvenswa Enterprises Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides information technology consultancy and software development services in India. The company offers EmPortal, an employee portal for tracking their tasks and timesheets; EdVision, an asset visualization tool that enable organizations to walk through warehouse floors without physically visiting the facility; ThinkAyurvedaFirst, an integrated platform for managing Ayurvedic healthcare services, including patient care, treatment tracking, and health management; ZSecurity, an application for operational security needs; and Scool, an application for parents and schools for managing and tracking the day-to-day pick-up and drop-off schedules and logistics of the children. It also offers CRM services, custom marketing software development, human resources, E-learning solutions, documentation automation software, supply chain software development, fleet management, financial management, ERP software, enterprise asset management consulting, custom project management, data analytics services, digital commerce agency, web portal development services, and content management system services. The company was formerly known as KLK Electrical Limited and changed its name to Edvenswa Enterprises Limited in November 2022. Edvenswa Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
